title: EMOM 20: 10 kettlebell swings / 10 push-ups
creator: Common EMOM template
description: Twenty minutes alternating minutes: odd minutes 10 kettlebell swings, even minutes 10 push-ups. Each movement gets almost two minutes to recover, so the reps should stay crisp. Modelled as ten 2-minute rounds; start the swings on the minute and the push-ups at the top of the next.
